text.p: The following are leading domestic stories in Portuguese newspapers.
- Government plans reforms to bourse regulations that will increase powers of control of Financial Markets Committee (CMVM).

- State electricity company EDP-Electricidade de Portugal, which due for privatisation next month, will need to top up its pension fund by 15 billion escudos if retired employees win action they taking against the company.
_ Prime Minister Antonio Guterres said the rigorous management of the social security system will allow savings of 75 billion escudos this year.
- The global coordinator for the privatisation of EDP is going to recommend a price of between 2,100 and 2,600 escudos per share, the paper says without revealing its sources.
- Soporcel should buy another pulp production machine if it wants to reduce prices in order to compete with Asian and South-American companies, a report from Arjo Wiggins Appleton said.
- International clothes and shoe makers are switching operations to Spain because of pirating of their brand names in Portugal.

- Analysts believe Lisbon bourse has exhausted its possibilities for gains after strong rise due to the announcemnent of the inclusion of the Portuguese market in the developed countries' Morgan stanley index.
